name: Moraas (Germany)
description: Vertically divided red and yellow, charged at the centre with the municipal arms of Moraas (a black dragon on yellow and a white Maltese cross on red).
history: The arms were approved on 2 April 1998 and registered as no. 159 in the roll of arms of Mecklenburg-Vorpommern; the flag was approved by the Ministry of the Interior on 24 October 2001.

features.role: Moraas arms — dragon and Maltese cross
